text: Managing a team is a challenging but rewarding job. Good communication is the foundation of success, so leaders should share clear goals and listen to their team members. Delegation is also important because it builds trust and helps people grow. Giving regular feedback allows employees to improve and feel valued. Motivation comes from recognising hard work and supporting development. Finally, conflict resolution skills are essential, as disagreements will happen. A good leader listens to both sides and finds fair solutions. By combining these skills, managers can create a positive working environment where everyone feels respected and motivated to do their best.
